meta.note: Opens the China seam. The China Statistical Yearbook and every provincial yearbook put a 简要说明 (Brief Introduction) at the head of each chapter whose stated purpose is to disclose that chapter's data sources, scope and method, and it names the NBS instruments BY TITLE. This slice mints those instruments as nodes and wires the national yearbook to them, plus the GB/T 4754 -> ISIC chain and one provincial pilot (Jiangsu). Every quote read live from the cited URL on the live host. Guangdong added 2026-09-08 after Thomas ruled that a first-party zip is a direct read: 4 more edges off the CD-edition archive.

reports.title: 国民经济行业分类 (Industrial Classification for National Economic Activities), GB/T 4754-2017
reports.publisher: 中国国家标准化管理委员会 (Standardization Administration of China)
reports.description: China's mandatory national standard for classifying economic activity, GB/T 4754-2017, replacing GB/T 4754-2011. Proposed by the National Bureau of Statistics (本标准由国家统计局提出) and issued 2017-06-30, effective 2017-10-01. Its own 前言 states it was drafted by the redrafting method with reference to the UN Statistical Commission's ISIC Rev.4, records its degree of correspondence to ISIC Rev.4 as 非等效 (NEQ, non-equivalent), and carries a full ISIC concordance as 附录 G. It is the classification every Chinese statistical yearbook, national and provincial, declares its industry breakdowns follow, which makes it the hub through which China's subnational statistics reach an international standard.
reports.cadence_note: Not a periodic release. A standing national standard revised roughly every 6-10 years: 1984, 1994, 2002, 2011, 2017, plus 第1号修改单 (Amendment 1) incorporated in the 2025 reissue read for this round.

reports.title: 建筑业统计报表制度 (Construction Industry Statistical Reporting System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system that defines the annual and periodic statistical returns construction enterprises file: which units report, the forms, the indicators and the reporting chain. Reissued annually; the edition read for this round covers the 2025 annual report and the 2026 periodic returns. The China Statistical Yearbook's construction chapter states its data are compiled from this system's annual returns.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one statistical year's annual report and the following year's periodic returns.

reports.title: 房地产开发统计报表制度 (Real Estate Development Statistical Reporting System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system governing statistical returns from real-estate development enterprises — reporting units, forms and indicators for investment, floor space and sales. Reissued annually. The China Statistical Yearbook's real-estate chapter states its data are collected and compiled under this system by complete enumeration.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one statistical year's annual report and the following year's periodic returns.

reports.title: 劳动工资统计报表制度 (Labour and Wage Statistical Reporting System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system for employment and wage returns from legal-person units. Its survey scope is all legal-person units, as the China Statistical Yearbook's employment chapter states in the same breath as the scope of the separate labour force survey system. Reissued annually.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one statistical year's annual report and the following year's periodic returns.

reports.title: 劳动力调查制度 (Labour Force Survey System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS instrument governing China's labour force survey — sampling, questionnaire, periodicity and reporting. Distinct from the survey itself (cn-labour-force-survey): this is the document that specifies how the survey is run, and it is what the China Statistical Yearbook names alongside the labour and wage reporting system as the two sources its employment chapter draws on. Its survey scope is urban and rural areas of the Chinese mainland.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually for the following year's periodic returns; the edition read for this round covers the 2026 periodic statistical returns.

reports.title: 农林牧渔业统计报表制度 (Agriculture, Forestry, Animal Husbandry and Fishery Statistical Reporting System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system for agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fishery statistics, defining the returns collected by NBS's Department of Rural Socio-Economic Survey. It is the source the China Statistical Yearbook names for its crop, livestock and agricultural-production-conditions data, and it is separately named by provincial yearbooks for the same chapters.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one statistical year's annual report and the following year's periodic returns.

reports.title: 农业产值和价格综合统计报表制度 (Agricultural Output Value and Price Comprehensive Statistical Reporting System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system covering gross output value and prices for agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fishery. Separate from the production-side agriculture reporting system and named separately by the China Statistical Yearbook, which attributes its agricultural output-value series to it.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one statistical year's annual report and the following year's periodic returns.

dependencies.basis: SELF-DECLARED: GB/T 4754-2017's own 前言 states the standard was drafted by the redrafting method with reference to the International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities (2006, Revision 4) established by the UN Statistical Commission, and its cover page carries the formal correspondence declaration '(UNSD:2006, International standard industrial classification of all economic activities, NEQ)'. CAVEAT, recorded because it is what the document itself says: the declared degree of correspondence is 非等效 (NEQ, non-equivalent), the weakest of the three GB correspondence grades — the standard was drafted from ISIC Rev.4 and carries a full ISIC concordance as 附录 G, but does not claim to reproduce it. Read live from the cited URL (HTTP 200) on 2026-09-08; the English title on the cover is what names the target for the matcher.
